intent: An assistant reply with inline citation marks and a source list. Marks are real links; a missing source shows as a broken cite.
useWhen: an assistant answer that cites documents, pages or files
let people jump from a mark to its source
flag a source that no longer exists
doNotUseWhen: a plain list of links — LinkList

citations.note: { id, title, href?, origin?, snippet?, missing?, missingReason? }[]; id matches the mark.

onCitationClick.note: (id) => void. The list opens, the source highlights and takes focus.

requirements: marks are links named "Source N: title" and move focus to the source
the sources toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls
external source links say they open a new tab
a missing source is said in text, not colour alone
loading uses kit ShimmerText; error is role=alert
the highlight fades on opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local CitedMessage, SourcesList, or Footnotes
Do not render marks as plain text
snippet: <CitedAnswer time="14:02" content="Store totals as integer cents[1]. Floats are not allowed for money[2]." citations={[{ id: "1", title: "Billing API · Rounding rules", href: "https://docs.example.com/billing/rounding", origin: "docs.example.com/billing/rounding" }, { id: "2", title: "RFC 017 · Money types" }]} />
